title: 2436940
output: html_fragment
params:
  language: "en"
---

<style>
h1.title {
  display: none;
}
.species-card {
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 680px;
  color: #2c3e50;
  line-height: 1.5;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.species-card h2 {
  margin: 0 0 2px 0;
  font-size: 1.6em;
  color: #1a252f;
  border-bottom: none;
}
.species-scientific {
  font-size: 1.15em;
  font-style: italic;
  color: #607d8b;
  margin: 0 0 14px 0;
}
.species-figure {
  margin: 0 0 18px 0;
}
.species-figure img {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 400px;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  display: block;
}
.species-copyright {
  font-size: 0.78em;
  color: #7f8c8d;
  margin-top: 5px;
  display: block;
}
.links-box {
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  background-color: #f8fafc;
  border-left: 6px solid #356196;
  border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;
  padding: 16px 22px;
}
.links-box h4 {
  margin: 0 0 10px 0;
  font-size: 1.05em;
  color: #1a252f;
}
.links-box p {
  margin: 0 0 10px 0;
  font-size: 0.95em;
}
.links-box p:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
.species-card a, .species-card a:visited {
  color: #0066cc;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.species-card a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}
</style>


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r sharedinfo, echo=FALSE}
VBP_link <- "https://natuurdata.inbo.be/bie-hub/species/2436940"
VBP_link_en <- "https://natuurdata.inbo.be/bie-hub/species/2436940?lang=en"
image_link<-"../Pictures/"

```


```{r nl_chunk, eval = params$language == "nl", results = "asis", echo=FALSE }
cat(paste0('
<div class="species-card">
<h2>Konijn</h2>
<p class="species-scientific">Oryctolagus cuniculus</p>

<div class="links-box">
<h4>Nuttige links</h4>
<p>Meer informatie over de konijn kunt u vinden op het <a href="', VBP_link, '" target="_blank">Vlaams Biodiversiteitsportaal</a>.</p>
<p>De konijn is in Vlaanderen geclassificeerd als jachtwildsoort. Meer info met betrekking tot het beheer en schade in Vlaanderen vindt u terug op de <a href="https://faunabeheer.inbo.be/app/01_faunabeheer/?specie=Konijn&gbifkey=2436940" target="_blank">faunabeheer pagina</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
'))
```

```{r en_chunk, eval = params$language == "en", results = "asis", echo=FALSE }
cat(paste0('
<div class="species-card">
<h2>European rabbit</h2>
<p class="species-scientific">Oryctolagus cuniculus</p>

<div class="links-box">
<h4>Useful links</h4>
<p>You can find more information about the European rabbit on the <a href="', VBP_link_en, '" target="_blank">Flemish Biodiversity Portal</a>.</p> <p>The european rabbit is classified as a game species in Flanders. More information concerning management and damages in Flanders can be found on the <a href="https://faunabeheer.inbo.be/app/01_faunabeheer/?specie=Konijn&gbifkey=2436940" target="_blank">wildlife management page</a> (note that this information is currently only available in Dutch).</p>
</div>
</div>
'))
```
